name: FlashArray - nightly DR drill
description: Every night at 02:00 run the DR drill job template (on each replication target, copy a volume out of the latest fully transferred snapshot of the replicated protection group, verify it, destroy it) and raise an incident when any drill failed; otherwise log a one-line summary. A schedule missed while the orchestrator was down is skipped, not caught up.

nodes.name: Notify: a DR plan has stopped working

extra_vars.subject: DR drill: ${dr_drill.artifacts.failed_count} drill(s) failed
extra_vars.detail: A replicated protection group had no completed snapshot to copy from, or the copy could not be made or did not match. Each drill's dr_drill record in the alert log names the target array, the protection group and the error. AAP job: ${dr_drill.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: DR drill: every configured drill copied and verified a volume from its latest replicated snapshot
